meta.name: Exact · polyhedral norms
meta.regime: Exact search CVP for rational polyhedral norms, target in the lattice span
meta.rules: Given a rational centrally symmetric full-dimensional polytope with s inequalities, a rational full-rank lattice and a target in its span, return a closest vector in the induced norm. Count arithmetic operations; keep the polynomial factor in s and the coefficient bit length explicit. This is a polyhedral-norm guarantee, not a result for an arbitrary oracle norm.
